stem: 关于美国法律和法规的域外效力，以下哪项陈述是准确的？

options.A: 《银行保密法》（BSA）的域外效力要求“旅行规则”适用于全球所有金融机构，包括所有美元交易
options.B: 2020年《反洗钱法》（AML法）的域外效力涵盖全球范围内所有以美元计价的交易
options.C: 美国海外资产控制办公室（OFAC）的经济和贸易制裁可能会给美国境外的金融机构和企业带来域外风险
options.D: 《美国爱国者法案》第319(b)条的域外效力允许扣押在美国开设并为外国银行维持的代理银行账户中的资金

stem_en: Which statement about the extraterritorial reach of U.S. laws and legislation is accurate?

options_en.A: The Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) extraterritorial reach requires that the Travel Rule be applied to all financial institutions globally, including all USD transactions
options_en.B: The Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020 (AML Act) extraterritorial reach covers all USD transactions throughout the global economy
options_en.C: The Office of Foreign Assets Control's (OFAC's) economic and trade sanctions may pose extraterritorial risks for financial institutions and businesses outside of the U.S.
options_en.D: Section 319(b) of the USA PATRIOT Act's extraterritorial reach allows funds in correspondent bank accounts opened in the U.S. and maintained for foreign banks to be seized
